cardA.title: Immediate release and granting of self-reporter status
cardA.description: In summary proceedings initiated by Pejman Salim, the preliminary relief judge ruled on the application of the Act revising the enforcement of criminal law decisions (Wet USB) and ordered the immediate release of the convicted person and the granting of self-reporter status.

cardD.title: Incidental claim for intervention | ex Article 217 Rv
cardD.description: A person who is not a party to ongoing proceedings can successfully file a claim for intervention if he meets two conditions: (i) he must have a sufficient interest in intervening in the proceedings in connection with any adverse consequences he may suffer as a result of the judgment in the main action, and (ii) he must assert that he wishes to bring an independent claim in the main action
